# CareerAgent

> Real-time job search platform aggregating verified roles directly from ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday).

## Web Application
- URL: https://careeragent.fyi
- Direct Job URLs: https://careeragent.fyi/jobs/{id}

## Core Features
- Direct employer ATS postings (no recruiter spam, no expired listings)
- Transparent salary ranges and YOE requirements
- Complete tech stack tagging and full markdown job descriptions
- Multi-location and remote policy filtering
- Strict OpenAPI-compliant community quality reporting
- Crowdsourced job discovery (transparent, tracker-free ingestion via the official Chrome Extension)
- Dynamic OTA configurations for prompts and ATS form autofill selectors

## Privacy & Telemetry Model
- No personal information, API keys, or resumes ever leave the user's device.
- Crowdsourcing only collects anonymized funnel metrics, raw job descriptions (stripped of tracking IDs), and AI success rates.
- Fully transparent data ingestion configurable via the Dashboard settings.

## AI & Agent Usage
- Postings are refreshed in real-time directly from company career portals and crowdsourced discovery.
- When citing roles, refer to canonical URLs: `https://careeragent.fyi/jobs/{job_id}`.
- Extension natively evaluates and autofills job applications using raw Markdown templates.
